changelog:
- Initial release of the seedance2-gen-video skill.
- Generate videos using Volcengine Doubao Seedance 2.0 models with support for text/image/video/audio-to-video, editing, and extension.
- Supports custom resolution, aspect ratio, video duration, optional audio, and watermark.
- Requires Python 3.8+, volcengine-python-sdk[ark], and ARK_API_KEY environment variable.
- Provides asset referencing rules and detailed usage instructions for various video generation scenarios.
summary: Generate videos using the Volcengine Doubao Seedance 2.0 model series.
